description: Ecwid is a multi-channel ecommerce platform enabling businesses to build online stores and sell across websites, social media, and marketplaces.
auth_notes: OAuth2 auth code flow for public apps; access tokens / store ID and secret tokens for private apps and custom integrations.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up for a free Ecwid account and create custom apps or private tokens via the control panel self-serve at no cost.
api_notes: Comprehensive REST API covering products, categories, orders, customers, discounts, shipping, and payment settings.
mcp_notes: No official MCP server published by Ecwid; community MCP servers may exist independently.
rationale: Ecwid provides fully documented public REST APIs, OAuth2/token authentication, and free self-serve developer account creation.

evidence.note: Describes authentication options including OAuth2 and private app access tokens.
Shows the main documentation portal covering REST API, store themes, webhooks, and JS API features.
